svg.title: 落沙 and SANDFALL pixel-grain lockup
svg.desc: Sandfall / 落沙 logo built from illuminated square sand grains joined by a horizontal stream.
svg.metadata: ART-B02. Chinese skeleton sampled from Noto Sans SC Bold and rebuilt as square vector grains; English paths derived from Oxanium SemiBold. Source fonts use SIL OFL 1.1.
